arcadeonchain.label: arcadeonchain
arcadeonchain.description: A dark arcade room with three cabinets. The shutter goes up, the tubes strike, and the machines roll in. Insert a coin — a real 1 PAS transfer, signed by you and watched into a block — and the room scales until that cabinet screen fills your view. The games run in the page on emulators built into it: JEZNES on a NES (boingoing, MIT), Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe and Geometrix on a Game Boy Color (Tangram Games, MIT + CC BY 4.0; AntonioND, GPL-3.0-or-later). Every cartridge carries an explicit licence permitting redistribution, shown on screen with its author and a link to its source. Frames are drawn through a phosphor tube: scanlines at the machine own line count, bloom, and no softening of a single pixel.

ascendyendor00.label: ascendyendor00
ascendyendor00.description: An ASCII fantasy roguelike. Descend to recover the Amulet of Yendor, and ascend.

chainpulse.label: chainpulse
chainpulse.description: Live vitals for the Products Devnet system chains — blocks, finality lag, block times.

chatgpt-guide.label: chatgpt-guide
chatgpt-guide.description: Interactive Chinese guide to Wolfram's 'What Is ChatGPT Doing' — 10 stops, 9 hands-on demos.

chirponchain.label: chirponchain
chirponchain.description: X, on chain. Every post, like, follow and reply is a contract call on Asset Hub — no server holds any of it, and reading needs no wallet. You post as a mask bound to your account, so a chirp cannot be forged.

chirpwatch.label: chirpwatch
chirpwatch.description: Are the chirp contracts answering, and are their numbers moving? Read live from Asset Hub, with no indexer in between.

chopdotproof01.label: chopdotproof01
chopdotproof01.description: Group money coordination for expenses, savings circles, emergency pots, and community funds.

confidaoapp.label: confidaoapp
confidaoapp.description: A 20-seat DAO where proposals are readable only by members, and ballots are secret from everyone including the app operator.

countersign.label: countersign
countersign.description: Record a document sign-off on chain. The document never leaves your browser.

devnet-atlas.label: devnet-atlas
devnet-atlas.description: Bilingual (中/EN) illustrated map of the Polkadot Products Devnet: 3 chains, publish pipeline, commit-reveal, ring VRF & KZG.

devnetpulse.label: devnetpulse
devnetpulse.description: An on-chain status board for the Products Devnet itself. Named reporters append probe results to a contract, so every claim carries the address that filed it and a clock for how long it held.

dforms-app.label: dforms-app
dforms-app.description: Encrypted forms on Polkadot. Responses are readable only by their creator.

discreetly.label: discreetly
discreetly.description: Private bookings for real people: anonymous verified humans, escrow deposits, kept-word reputation.

dot-drive.label: dot-drive
dot-drive.description: Big files, encrypted on your device and stored on Bulletin, with the key handed over in a sealed letter. The bytes are unreadable and nothing points at them. Fourteen days, then gone, and the app says so on every row.

dot-pages.label: dot-pages
dot-pages.description: Tap-to-build websites, published to a .dot name — no backend, no build step.

dot-store.label: dot-store
dot-store.description: Every app registered on the Polkadot Products devnet, with real screenshots and on-chain reviews. Read from the chain on every load.

dotfinder.label: dotfinder
dotfinder.description: Check DotNS name availability directly on Products Devnet.

dotify-test01.label: dotify-test01
dotify-test01.description: Shared musical presence with artist-owned access and value flows.

dotmailbox.label: dotmailbox
dotmailbox.description: Sealed mail on Asset Hub. No envelope names its recipient, so nobody can see who writes to whom. Reads an ordinary mailbox too, kept visibly apart.

dotmetrics.label: dotmetrics
dotmetrics.description: The index of the .dot ecosystem: every app discovered on-chain, growth and live analytics.

doyoulike.label: doyoulike
doyoulike.description: Independent on-chain opinion polls. Vote yes or no with your wallet.

dragon-realm.label: dragon-realm
dragon-realm.description: Let the dragons show you the weather.

dripstream.label: dripstream
dripstream.description: Payment streams in native PAS. Lock funds once and they unlock to the recipient every second. They pull whatever the clock has released; you cancel and reclaim only what has not vested yet.

dropforge.label: dropforge
dropforge.description: Launch an NFT collection in one transaction. One call deploys a real ERC-721 at its own address, and the art is a pure function of algorithm, palette and seed inside a renderer contract.

dw3labsgame.label: dw3labsgame
dw3labsgame.description: A platformer whose score is proven, not claimed. Play a run, then watch a TEE on the Acurast network replay your keypresses, recompute the score itself, and sign it for a contract on Polkadot Asset Hub.

ethonchain.label: ethonchain
ethonchain.description: Six real pages from ethereum.org served from a content hash, with no server behind them. Unofficial demonstration; provenance measured in your browser.

exit-radar.label: exit-radar
exit-radar.description: Finds addresses that repeatedly move DOT toward fiat exposure — transfers to tagged centralized-exchange addresses, plus on-chain DOT to USDC/USDT swaps on Asset Hub. Scores and ranks by volume, frequency, timing regularity, round-number amounts, net outflow and clustering.

flowfarm-staking.label: flowfarm-staking
flowfarm-staking.description: Explore finalized staking data and inspect an active PAS reward-advance vault on Devnet.

gameboyonchain.label: gameboyonchain
gameboyonchain.description: Twenty Game Boy Color homebrew cartridges, emulated in the page — nothing is fetched from anywhere else. Every one carries an explicit licence permitting redistribution: MIT, Zlib, Apache-2.0, GPL and CC-BY-SA. Titles include Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe, Dawn Will Come, GB Corp., uCity and Geometrix. Author, licence and source are shown on each game screen; the copyleft titles link the corresponding source as their licence requires. Browse the whole handheld, then pick a cartridge and it scales up to play.

hahamingx00.label: hahamingx00
hahamingx00.description: The decentralized web, in your browser — powered by .dot Web ID.

italiarovente.label: italiarovente
italiarovente.description: How much hotter Italy has become since 1940: stripes, records, seas, 107 cities.

nesonchain.label: nesonchain
nesonchain.description: Fifteen freely-licensed NES homebrew games, emulated in the page — nothing is fetched from anywhere else and nothing you press leaves it. Every title ships its author's own release build under an SPDX licence that permits redistribution: MIT, Zlib, Unlicense and GPL-3.0. Author, licence and source repository are shown on each game screen, and the GPL titles link the corresponding source as the licence requires.

oblv-wg-calc.label: oblv-wg-calc
oblv-wg-calc.description: Calculatrice sur le dashboard : expression complète, scientifique, historique réutilisable. Aucun réseau.

oblv-wg-calendar.label: oblv-wg-calendar
oblv-wg-calendar.description: Calendrier du dashboard : le mois en un coup d’œil, l’agenda du jour, saisie en une ligne (jour, heure, récurrence), tout en local.

oblv-wg-clock.label: oblv-wg-clock
oblv-wg-clock.description: Horloge sur le dashboard : cadran, afficheur à segments ou chiffres, au choix, dans n'importe quel fuseau.

oblv-wg-crypto.label: oblv-wg-crypto
oblv-wg-crypto.description: Suivi de prix crypto sur le dashboard : watchlist personnalisable, variation 24 h et tendance 7 jours.

oblv-wg-opengov.label: oblv-wg-opengov
oblv-wg-opengov.description: Suivi des référendums OpenGov ouverts au vote sur Polkadot : état, tally aye/nay, seuils d'approbation et de support de la track, et temps restant avant échéance.

oblv-wg-rss.label: oblv-wg-rss
oblv-wg-rss.description: Votre lecteur RSS sur le dashboard : vos flux fusionnés en une timeline, non-lus mis en avant, article ouvert d'un clic.

oblv-wg-todo.label: oblv-wg-todo
oblv-wg-todo.description: Write a task the way you would say it - “pay rent friday !!” - and it files itself by date, priority and tag. Everything stays on your device.

oblv-wg-weather.label: oblv-wg-weather
oblv-wg-weather.description: Météo sur le dashboard : conditions actuelles, heures à venir et prévisions 7 jours.

oblv-widgets.label: oblv-widgets
oblv-widgets.description: Widgets pour le dashboard : solde des comptes, et plus à venir.

open-docs.label: open-docs
open-docs.description: Collaborative documents with verifiable save points.

openpetition.label: openpetition
openpetition.description: Petitions signed by real people: one signature per person, verifiable by anyone.

parlement-populaire.label: parlement-populaire
parlement-populaire.description: Comprendre les mesures, voter, débattre et vérifier les résultats sur Polkadot.

pennypixel.label: pennypixel
pennypixel.description: A 32x32 canvas nobody owns. Twenty five cents buys twenty five pixels, and a whole painting session batches into one signature. The canvas is the contract state, packed four bits per cell.

peoplebook.label: peoplebook
peoplebook.description: The devnet identity directory, where every handle has a claimable on-chain avatar NFT. Read live from the People chain: every person who registered a .dot-style handle gets a generated mask. Claim yours for 1 PAS and the PeoplebookAvatars contract (deployed on the devnet Asset Hub) mints an ERC-721 to you and rolls its rarity on chain, gacha-style: Legendary 3%, Epic 10%, Rare 20%, Uncommon 30%, Common 37%. The image is generated inside the contract, so the NFT shows in any wallet with nothing hosted anywhere. Own a .dot? Add it at claim and the contract verifies it against the registry for better odds. Searchable, self-updating as people claim.

peoplewiki.label: peoplewiki
peoplewiki.description: What the Polkadot products devnet actually does — written down by the people using it, kept on chain, open to anyone with a mask.

polkanote.label: polkanote
polkanote.description: Collaborative documents with verifiable save points.

proofoftake.label: proofoftake
proofoftake.description: A leaderboard of takes where one account is one vote and the ranking is a contract read, not an API. No server decides the order. Post a take, vote once on each, watch the board reorder.

quizzlergame.label: quizzlergame
quizzlergame.description: A live social trivia game for friends.

radioactivedrums.label: radioactivedrums
radioactivedrums.description: A drum machine living entirely on-chain — 8 synthesized voices, 16-step sequencer, zero servers.

rainbow-dev.label: rainbow-dev
rainbow-dev.description: A platformer whose score is proven, not claimed. Play a run, then watch a TEE on the Acurast network replay your keypresses, recompute the score itself, and sign it for a contract on Polkadot Asset Hub.

stake-forensics.label: stake-forensics
stake-forensics.description: Pattern detection across Polkadot unbonding activity. Scans a configurable historical window, scores addresses by volume, frequency, timing regularity, round-number amounts, net outflow and clustering, and flags the ones most likely to be generating repeat sell pressure.

stealcrown.label: stealcrown
stealcrown.description: One crown, one holder, and a clock that runs while you keep it. Anyone can take it from anyone, so the board ranks time held rather than money spent. Reading the throne needs no wallet.

substrade-hub.label: substrade-hub
substrade-hub.description: Fully on-chain order-book DEX on Asset Hub.

thebutton.label: thebutton
thebutton.description: One button. One press per human, ever. A proof-of-personhood experiment.

tintaprotocol.label: tintaprotocol
tintaprotocol.description: Sella lo que escribes. Cualquiera puede comprobar que no cambió.

torrent-otp.label: torrent-otp
torrent-otp.description: A serverless BitTorrent tracker. Announces are signed statements, not requests to a server.

truereviews.label: truereviews
truereviews.description: Reviews you can trust: one verified human, one review per place, on real map businesses.

trustgraph.label: trustgraph
trustgraph.description: Reputation with no verified badge. Any address can vouch for another, with a type and an expiry, and revoke it later. You never get a yes or no, you get who said what and whether it stands.

unstake-radar.label: unstake-radar
unstake-radar.description: Live radar for Polkadot staking & unstaking. Ranks unstakes by volume, flags potential sell pressure with a red alarm beacon, and tracks the current 2-day unbonding countdown.

vault-control.label: vault-control
vault-control.description: A security-first control center for your Polkadot accounts: multisigs, keyless cold vaults, delegations - every action approved on your phone.

waldmonster.label: waldmonster
waldmonster.description: 9-oscillator drone workstation & groovebox for spherical soundscapes.

wudcommunity.label: wudcommunity
wudcommunity.description: Unofficial WUD dashboard: live supply, holders, whale-to-plankton leaderboard.
